purpose: Read-only descriptive audit of uploaded incumbent ConductorHybrid manual pair judgments. No preference model fitted and no promotion decision inferred.
source_hash_note: SHA-256 values identify local files at audit creation. These do not establish which code/checkpoint versions originally generated the legacy videos. Tensor membership hash covers the UTF-8 meta value only; no claim of a full tensor checksum.

source_hashes.scope: NPZ meta member value UTF-8, not entire tensor

screen_brightness_proxy.description: CPU FFmpeg decoding of every frame of each stored MP4, resize each frame to 64x36 and convert to grayscale; take arithmetic mean of all uint8 pixels over all frames divided by255. Every video produced900 frames. This is a reproducible gamma-encoded screen appearance proxy, not calibrated physical/perceptual luminance.
screen_brightness_proxy.aggregation_python: a = np.frombuffer(completed_process.stdout, dtype=np.uint8); mean_gray = float(a.mean()) / 255.0; frames = int(a.size // (64 * 36))
screen_brightness_proxy.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version n9.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
notes: A preceding exploratory run sampled at1 fps. The final values in this artifact supersede that run and use all900 frames, avoiding temporal sampling aliasing.
No GPU rendering or processing was launched.

metadata_brightness.description: Use stored pairs.json brightness entries without regenerating or altering the legacy batch. They are level_features(...)[mean] from the decoded DMX metric, not video-pixel measurements.

ratings.description: Join every ratings.jsonl row to pairs.json by id. Compare each question independently; identify default arms by exact dictionary equality to pairs.json defaults. Count brighter-arm wins descriptively without fitting or hypothesis testing.

identities.description: Resolve each music_id through justdance_songs.json rows. Reproduce current make_jd_splits(meta, seed=0, val_frac=.1, test_frac=.15) on current train_tensor_jd_none.npz metadata. Same-title filename matches are candidate identity defects, not confirmed audio duplicates.

knob_sensitivity.description: CPU-only check on current incumbent checkpoint and pair000, pair019, pair038. For each, load corresponding motion metadata only to recover start_s offset; slice cached audio bus at offset+pair start_s for30 seconds; predict descriptors with fixed seed0; hold descriptors/bus fixed and compare default packed DMX to every one-knob low/high endpoint setting from KNOBS.
knob_sensitivity.execution_prefix: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 bash run_torch.sh -
knob_sensitivity.limitation: Establishes code-path activity on these current CPU reproductions, not identical reconstruction of the original GPU-sampled descriptors or every legacy material. No new video rendering.

findings.finding: Brightness metric and renderer disagree for blinders
evidence: /root/lightsem/lightsem/dmx/decode.py:71-75: blinder RGB is assigned dimmer, giving val=dimmer.
/root/lightsem/lightsem/dmx/decode.py:102-109: emitted_light multiplies dimmer by val, giving approximately dimmer squared for blinders.
/root/lightsem/lightsem/sim/renderer.py:175: rendered intensity is linear dimmer times intensity_gain.
findings.interpretation: This is a code-level mismatch. Screen brightness differences also depend on color, fixture geometry, area and tone mapping; this audit does not attribute the full screen proxy discrepancy to the blinder bug.

evidence: /root/lightsem/build_hl_pairs.py:86-92: phi_a is default or perturbed; phi_b is always perturbed and only that original arm is gain-scaled.
/root/lightsem/build_hl_pairs.py:98-104: displayed A/B order is randomized after gain scaling.
findings.interpretation: In default-versus-perturbed comparisons the default is unscaled and the perturbation is normalized. Raw knob differences do not fully describe resulting rendered exposure; gain is not recorded. The measured preference is for this generation protocol.

findings.finding: All nine knobs are connected, with hybrid-specific scope
findings.interpretation: All nine changed DMX in54/54 endpoint sensitivity checks. Hybrid recomputes beam and event amplitudes with default squash gain, so contrast_gain mainly reaches the inherited wash/back/saturation/strobe controls rather than every layer.

findings.finding: Descriptive pilot does not establish a default improvement
findings.interpretation: Each question preferred the default8/18 times versus random perturbations and the screen-proxy-brighter arm20/39 times overall. These counts neither establish useful tuning nor show that the rater merely prefers brightness. No foils were collected, and one rater's39 labels over29 existing registry groups are exploratory.

findings.finding: This batch concerns the older incumbent conductor
findings.interpretation: The nine knobs do not include GroupEngine wave or hue-spread/drift controls. These judgments do not directly validate the later wave-and-colour renderer.
